title: Spreading Life and remixing Live While You Can
summary: Eddie Bo talked Ridgley into funding a label for a tune already cut; Ridgley remixed the Live While You Can master from Mrs. Walker's tape with Allen Toussaint's help.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
